name: Florida
authority: Florida Department of State, Notary Section (appointments by the Governor)
notes: Florida does not give a state notary exam; first-time applicants complete a three-hour education course. This mock exam is a self-check on the same law: 40 questions in one hour, 70% to pass.
disclaimer: Study aid only, not legal advice. Questions are based on Chapter 117, Florida Statutes, and the Governor's Reference Manual for Notaries. Check the Department of State's current notary publications before relying on any rule.
